purpose: actual batch order, per-item failure/expiry/replay semantics and frontend admission rules

new_window_policy: Only if reused window lacks target: discover finalized and register the last 500 inclusive blocks before new logs; separately register targeted single-block followups before reads. No retrospective change.
selection: fixed block/transaction/log order; first batch with a failed item, all failures in reused window; first claim and any observed withdrawal for same chain account, no link to user reports; otherwise first withdrawal event in registered window
rules: read only; existing public endpoints only; no new credentials/cost
all errors/retries count; stop on denial or rate limit
no account API interrogation beyond public aggregate sources; any chain addresses kept private
distinguish internally credited, withdrawal action and externally confirmed receipt
retain missing stages and avoid time/funds provenance inference
